employees.basis: full-time employees in the United States and Ireland (plus 73 part-time employees, not counted here)

source.label: Fiscal 2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Employees and Human Capital Resources
source.quote: As of January 31, 2026, we had a total of 942 full-time employees and 73 part-time employees in the United States and Ireland

notes: Employees: the 942 full-time employees at January 31, 2026; the same sentence adds 73 part-time employees, which are not added because the 10-K states no combined total. Payroll is null: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, wages or personnel costs (payroll is described only as a component of fulfillment, technology, marketing and G&A expenses), and the 2026 proxy contains no CEO pay ratio or median employee pay (no such disclosure was found in it).
